faq.title: Questions
faq.freeA: Yes. The tracker and the capture app are both free.
faq.modifyA: No. The app only reads network traffic on your PC or phone. It never touches the game's files or memory and needs no mods.
faq.readsA: What the game sends about your account: characters, weapons, artifacts, materials, achievements and wishes.
faq.adminA: Windows lets only administrators capture network packets.
faq.needA: No. You can import GOOD files into the tracker by hand.
faq.serversA: All of them: America, Europe, Asia and TW/HK/MO.
